notes.title: State of the Game :)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Lets start by saying this game is NOT abandoned...

As many of you know I have spent quite a bit of my time recently on trying to get a 3rd game out:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/593490/Empire_Architect/

I had to get a 3rd game out because, despite how much I and many of you love the game, Zavix Tower has not been profitable (in fact it is in a financial hole that I am not sure that it will ever get out of). In order to avoid bankruptcy (which would have forced me to abandon the game) I had to make Empire Architect. Sometimes you have to make hard decisions in life and business and this was a very hard one for me to make. Zavix Tower is one of the games I have wanted to make since I was a kid, and taking a break from it was very painful for me...


But there is the good news!


Empire Architect seems as though it will be profitable in a reasonable amount of time! What does that mean for Zavix Tower you ask? Well it means that when Zavix Tower makes money most of it can go back into the game to improve it! Right now the sales are VERY slow for Zavix Tower, but they are there. As they continue to come in I will continue to set aside both money and my time in order to make updates for the game.

The updates will start off slow, but there are things I still want to do with the game, and there are things you guys want. I am not promising you guys will get everything you want, but I will start to get the update train rolling again :)

What can you guys do:

1) If you want the updates to come faster the game has to sell more, and to do that it need more traffic. What increases traffic? Positive reviews, playing the game more, and sales themselves...

2) Tag the game (in the tags section on game's steam page)

3) Tell your friends about the game.

4) Talk about it on forums (both on steam and off).


Confusion about me not keeping my "promises":

Here is the deal guys. I did everything I promised I would do for this game. In fact I refused to start a 3rd game until the Druid was in the game (which all came out of my pocket due to the game not being profitable) because I had promised it. The Ranger and the Warlock were "Would like to haves", and I would still "like to have them", but I NEVER promised they would be in the game, I always said I would like to have them. There are many other things that I mentioned that I would like to have, But absolutely every Item that I promised (both in early access and there after) is in the game. I will always keep my promises to users, but me saying that I want something to be in the game, or that it would be cool to have XYZ, is not a promise...

I will always take promises very seriously... 

What is next:

Now that that is cleared up, I should be able to get a patch out this month (I am hoping to so at least) that will clean up some of the issues and bugs that have been found. After that I want to add a Hardcore mode next, so provided the game can pay for me to do that work, I will be adding that next. 

From there I will be listening to what you guys want (even though I cant be on the forums all the time anymore (and responding rapidly), I will be reading it all eventually and taking it into account. I may even start a poll from time to time in order to figure out what is next on the list.

Thank you all for sticking with the game! I hope to keep improving it over time

notes.title: Update 1.37 Compare All
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

So today I have bug fixes, and of bit of ease of life. Since the game first launched there has been requests for an easier way to deal with finding which new gear is good to keep. Well today I have made headway on the front, and you can now view what all your characters have equipped at the same time. All you have to do is simply hold the shift button while hovering over the new item, and all of your characters equipped items for that slot will appear on the screen.

Notes:

- Added Compare all by holding the shift key.
- Added the Portrait of the character to the compare tooltip.
- Fixed a bug in the "100 Year Storm" mage talent that was causing it to not always attack the extra target.
- Fixed a bug with Paladin Talent "Light Absorption" that could allow it to return 0 mana.
- Fixed a bug with the Priest "Light's Embrace" talent that caused it to only work on Heal All and Not Heal.
- The Warrior Talent "Shield Spikes" now states that it requires a shield.
- After battle the character screen will always open to the gear screen (rather than whatever screen was last opened).

If you are enjoying the game it would help me out a ton if you could take a few minutes and write a review for the game. Good reviews really make a huge difference :)

notes.title: Update 1.34 Druids!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Today is Druid day!

The Druid is the "Jack of all trades, but master of none" class. The Druid achieves this through different forms. The Bear is a tank form that is perfect for taking a good bit of damage. The Cat is a melee damage form that can put out solid damage. Lastly there is the caster or "Normal" form, this form has healing and damage spells that allow the druid to sit in the back row if needed. 

The Druid synergies with many of the other classes through poisons, bleeds, and HoTs. The druid is amazing at being the 2nd tank, and 2nd healer, and damage when possible. The Druids main weaknesses are that it has no crowd control and only has basic skills in each form.

The Druid is available after completing floor 10.

Notes:

- Druid Class (Yay).
- The Shaman will now starting showing up in the tavern after floor 5 has been completed, down from floor 10.
- Slightly reduced Last Stands mana cost.
- Updated Power Strikes tooltip.
- Updated Back Stabs tooltip.
- Updated Heal's tooltip
- Updated Smite's tooltip.
- Updated Fireball's tooltip.
- Updated Pyroblast's tooltip.
- Updated Frostbolt's tooltip.
- Updated Renew's tooltip.
- Updated Fireball Burns talent tooltip to reflect the actual damage.


I really hope you all like the new class! I am looking forward to getting feedback on it! 

The druid will be getting more skills and talents as time goes on, but for now it has more skills and talent points to spend than other class.

Lastly:

Make sure to Like/share us on Facebook so that you can keep up with what is going on. Thanks again for all your support!

https://www.facebook.com/batholithentertainment/

notes.title: Update 1.33 More Item Stats!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Today we have new item stats (I know, its been a long time coming). These stats are all in the "Rating" category. What this means for this game is that 1 point of "Rating" is equivalent to 1 point of the base stat that affects the specific stat. I understand that may be confusing but here is an example...

Ex 1) 1 Spell resist is = 1 point of spirit's spell resist value.

Ex 2) 1 Physical Resist = 1 point strength's physical resist value.

Ex 3) 1 Dodge Rating = 1 point Dexterity's dodge value.

I have more stats to put in but this will at least help to give some more variety as we just went from 6 stats to 11 (almost double). 

Because "Rating" values are only part of the base stat's functions, they are much cheaper on the item's stat cost. So for that reason you will often see them in much higher values. This should make it possible to stack stats for very specific functions.


Notes:

- Added Item Stat: Crit Rating.
- Added Item Stat: Spell Crit Rating.
- Added Item Stat: Dodge Rating.
- Added Item Stat: Spell Resist Rating.
- Added Item Stat: Physical Resist Rating.

notes.title: Update 1.25 Release Date, and Pally stuff!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We are happy to announce that the game will be leaving Early access on July 21st! We said in our Early Access summery that we planned to be in Early access for 3-4 months and that time has come to an end (in that time we have now posted 55 updates to the game, which we are super proud of), and we want all of you to know we keep our word... Combine that with the fact that we have completed all of our original goals with the game (actually much more than the starting goals), and we believe it is time to call it a "Finished" game. That being said the development will go on for a long time :)

We have a huge list of things that you guys have asked for, and we will be working for the foreseeable future to add tons of new things as time goes on. A few examples of these are more dungeon features, destructible environment pieces, secrets, more themes, more classes, more skills, more mobs, more things to spend signets on, consumable items, and the list goes on and on. So don’t feel like development is over!

Todays Patch:

Got some Paladin stuff for you today (I got one more skill for the pally coming soon). As well as arrows in the talent screen, some new background music, and a few bug fixes.

Notes:

- New Paladin Skill: Seal of Judgment, The target of this spell takes 10% more damage for 3 turns.
- New Paladin Talent: Improved Seal of Judgment, Seal of Judgment now increase damage done by 1% more per point spent.
- New Paladin Talent: Eternal Judgment, Seal of Judgment now lasts one extra turn.
- New Paladin Skill(Talented): Crusader's Fury, Does 50% damage to 3 seperate random targets. Takes both melee damage and spell damage into consideration.
- New Paladin Talent: Improved Crusader's Fury, Crusader's Fury now does 2% more damage per point spent.
- New Paladin Talent: Zealot's Fury, Crusader's Fury now attacks 1 more random target per point spent. (2 possible points)
- Added the Arrows to the talent tree (yay!)
- Now that we have arrows in the talent trees I was able to see, and then fix, some bugs. All talents currently are linked correctly now.
- New Background music for the Jungle floors (Made my Jessica Fichot www.jessicasongs.com, this piece was made specifically for this game).
- Fixed a bug where Paladins could equip a staff.
- I did some work on Saving of the settings file's in order to try to fix a bug. I spent quite a bit of time testing it, but let me know if you guys seen anything un usual...


Lastly we are 1% away from getting to a "Very Positive" rating on steam. So with our launch coming in one week, now would be a great time to post a review of the game if you have been holding off :) Being in the very positive range will help us tremendously, and we would be very grateful for your help getting there!

notes.title: 1.20 Start of Class Synergy
notes.content:
So in this patch we started adding some of the long promised class synergies. More will come, but this is a start.


- New Mage spell: Ignite, Ignites all enemey burn damage effects for 125% of the effect's full damage over time effect. (this consumes the burn effects)
- New Mage Spell: Blizzard, rains down damage on 2 random enemies per turn, the enemies get the Frost debuff. Lasts 3 turns.
- New Mage Spell(Talent): Meteor, does heavy damage to the target, as well as half damage to all adjacent units. All damaged units will also burn for 3 turns.
- New Warrior Skill(Talent): Mass Taunt, Mass Taunt taunts all enemies for 2 turns.
- New Warrior Talent: Power Bleed, Power Strike will now also cause the target to bleed for 25% damage over 4 turns. This requires 5 points in Power Strike (Cleave has been moved down 1 row and now does not require points in powerstrike).
- New Rogue Skill: Kidney Shot, Kidney shot does 100% weapon damage, as well as stuns the target for 1 turn. This skill has no cooldown.
- New Rogue Talent: Open Wounds, Backstab now does 5% damage more damage per talent point, per bleed. (example: if there are 2 bleeds on a target, and you have 3 points in open wounds. Then back stab will do 30% more damage.)
- Fixed a bug where new games would appear out of order.
- Ice Lance got a new icon
- Blizzard got the old ice lance icon.
- Burns now tell you what their base damage will be (keep in mind that resists still change this number).
- Bleeds now tell you what their base damage will be (keep in mind that resists still change this number).


We got tons to do for each class, so if your favorite one(s) didnt get any love on this patch, then its very likely they will on the next synergy patch we do. No class is considered complete, so there is more to come!

Also if you like the game (or where its going), and you have some feedback for us please let us know in either a review, or a forum post. We cant react to you feedback if its never given ;)

notes.title: New Partners & Monetization changes.
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

We’ve got some exciting new changes coming up to Zavix Tower in the next couple weeks. They are major adjustments to the game and our business model. We are making these changes in order to reach sustainability so that we can continue to work on Zavix Tower. 

First and foremost, we’re moving Zavix Tower from Free-to-Play to a Paid model. In the next two weeks, we’ll continue to offer the game as Free-to-Play, so you may continue to enjoy it until we make the change. 

On June 1, Zavix Tower will move into a final Beta stage, and its cost will move up to the price point of $15. We are working hard to make the necessary adjustments in-game and are looking forward to getting all the feedback from the community that we’ve come to depend on to ensure this is the game we all want. 

We know many of you want the game to stay free (and we did too), but that is just not possible at this time. That being said anyone who has purchased anything from the in game store will get the paid version of the game for free! The Gem Store will stay active until May 23rd, so if you want to get the game on the cheap then go make a gem purchase before the gem store closes. We will also be giving the game to anyone who has cleared floor 25 as of May 23rd as a thank you for all your testing!

On that last front, we’ve partnered with Indie Voyage (Reassembly, Venture Forth [coming soon]) to aid in the transition and with getting the word out to ensure we can continue to support Zavix Tower. Please stay tuned for more details and refer to the FAQ for any and all details. We’re looking at mid-July to officially move out of Early Access.

Thanks for your continued and dedicated support, we couldn’t do it without you.

Batholith Entertainment

notes.title: Update 1.07a Balancing
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

No major content today, but we are starting to focus more on getting the game more balanced.

- Gold has been re-tuned... Early game gold has gone up, and late game gold has gone down. We feel this is going to be a much better gold curve than before, and it will keep the game from going to exponential.
- Exp has been changed. When a party is full exp should be unchanged, however when the party is not full (or a character is dead), each character will get an extra portion of exp. EX) if you have 3 living party members then each will get a double the EXP.
- Fixed the bug where when you equip items your health and mana decrease.
- Fixed a bug where mobs health should show decimal values.
- more ground work for 4x3 support


Future things:
- We had decided to change the level cap for the game (we are working on figuring out the final balancing and this is a change we need to make), so sometime next week we will be caping your heros at level 50. If your characters are above level 50 they will get a free respec. We will be raising this level cap over time in the future.
- We are going to be working more on the end game. As such we are going to be tweaking with mobs, and adding better AI's.
- In the future we will also be splitting each class's talent tree in to 2 trees. This will allow us to put in the 2nd half of the tree, which will make substantial changes to your characters.

- Im working on a 2 new mobs and 1 new boss right now... One of the mobs has a brand new model as well. I hope to have them in tomorrow, but I may not get it all done in time... We shall see ;)
